_comment: One-shot forced tick — read by run-tick.ts `auto` on the NAS (which git-pulls main each tick). Fires ONCE inside [notBeforeUtc, expiresUtc) at the next IDLE hour (a scheduled tick wins its own hour); the done-stamp lives in the container's data/.tmp. To arm a new one: change `key` + the window + mode, commit. An expired file is inert — safe to leave in the repo. 2026-08-27 (macro build-out): generate ALL the new alt-data feeds off-schedule in one FULL — refresh-cot (Positioning), refresh-energy (Energy; keyless prices now, EIA balance pending EIA_API_KEY), refresh-econ-surprise (Surprises; starts thin, accretes), refresh-attention (Attention; Wikipedia pageviews). Also re-runs real-economy + valuation. Populates the four new Economy tabs without waiting for the 23:00 UTC scheduled FULL.
